{{Quote|I'm Agent Jaysa Wise, call sign "Nutcracker". The Republic has stationed a few of us here.|Jaysa Wise|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jaysa Wise''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Jaysa Wise along with a few other SIS agents was stationed in the Imperial-controlled [[High Security Lockdown]] section of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. One of their team, [[Karhel]], was apprehended by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and was about to give up the information on other agents when a fellow Republic citizen approached Jaysa. She planned to signal an escape, but couldn't do it without a massive distraction. For that end, she asked the Republic citizen to help her start a prison riot to cover the escape by releasing several dangerous criminals. After the prisoners broke out, one of them releasing a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] on his own, Jaysa thanked the individual and signaled call-signs [[Two-Moon]] and [[Star-Killer]] to abort their assignments and return to base.<ref name="TOR" />
